verdict.rationale: Google Workspace's Context-Aware Access lets admins create granular per-app access policies based on user identity, location, device security status, and IP address. That covers the network, device, location, and per-app parts of the story. Community reports confirm CAA is in real use and enforces device checks via Endpoint Verification, though they complain about troubleshooting. Missing for 10: documented risk-signal inputs (e.g. session or user risk scoring), documented scoping of CAA policies per group, and independent corroboration of policy depth.

support.subject: As a security engineer, access decisions weigh context — network, device, location, and risk signals drive conditional policies per app and group

citations.quote: you can create granular access control security policies for apps based on attributes, such as user identity, location, device security status, and IP address
